peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 10.2% above its local comparables; 103 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (76.8): 4.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 301 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 2). Initial resale-wave effect: 7 of the 15 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Apr 2025); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 45.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 3.4 resales per 100 homes a year over 17 months (May 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 224 of 379 similar developments. First resale wave from May 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 3 earlier resales do not start the wave. Observed 24-month activity: 4.5.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Haw Par Villa MRT about 520 m, Pasir Panjang MRT about 890 m; closer than 297 of 662 similar developments (the same as 19). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 0 within 2 km; nearest Fairfield Methodist School (Primary) about 2,360 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 0 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 1,580 m), more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 54); nearest hawker centre Pasir Panjang Food Centre about 830 m; nearest park Pasir Panjang Park about 100 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 4 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Terra Hill, 98 new sales, about 890 m; The Hillshore, 6 new sales, about 970 m; Lyndenwoods, 7 new sales, about 1,390 m; Hudson Place Residences, 226 new sales, about 1,950 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 50 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 337 new sales and 170 resales (507 purchases); new sales were 66.5% of these purchases. Subsales (53) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 170 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 4 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 170 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 114 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (+49.1%). Planning-area private resales −1.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
